author: Arbitra
rationale: A verification question carries related source (where the names used at the cited lines are defined, who calls the function they sit in, found by text and bounded in bytes), its source label no longer names the question so the prompts of a stage share their start, and for Claude Code the locked layer goes in the system prompt. A recorded run of 197 questions made 914 tool calls, 417 of them reading a file the question did not cite.
compatibilityNotes: a run pinned at 1.0.0 keeps asking its questions as 1.0.0 did, so its recorded answers replay and its resume asks the same input
